description: NaV₂O₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.08 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.04 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with four ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with four ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂V₃ square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three V atoms.
